    turnNum = int(input())
    # choices include rock, scissor, paper respectively
    aliceChoices = list(map(int, input().split(' ')))
    bobChoices = list(map(int, input().split(' ')))
    
    bobChoices.append(bobChoices.pop(0))
    minWin, maxWin = [0, 0]
    
    # calculate the maximum number of rounds Alice can win

        maxWin += min([choice, bobChoices[i]])

    maximum = max(aliceChoices)

            minWin = choice + bobChoices[i]
    minWin = minWin - turnNum if minWin > turnNum else 0
    print(f'{minWin} {maxWin}')

#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <algorithm>
#include <numeric>

int main() {
    int turnNum;
    std::cin >> turnNum;

    std::vector<int> aliceChoices(turnNum);
    for (int i = 0; i < turnNum; ++i) {
        std::cin >> aliceChoices[i];
    }

    std::vector<int> bobChoices(turnNum);
    for (int i = 0; i < turnNum; ++i) {
        std::cin >> bobChoices[i];
    }

    // Rotate bobChoices left by 1 (equivalent to bobChoices.append(bobChoices.pop(0)))
    int firstBob = bobChoices[0];
    for (int i = 0; i < turnNum - 1; ++i) {
        bobChoices[i] = bobChoices[i + 1];
    }
    bobChoices[turnNum - 1] = firstBob;

    int maxWin = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < turnNum; ++i) {
        maxWin += std::min(aliceChoices[i], bobChoices[i]);
    }

    int minWin = 0;

    // Using maximum of bobChoices
    int maxBob = *std::max_element(bobChoices.begin(), bobChoices.end());
    for (int i = 0; i < turnNum; ++i) {
        int choice = bobChoices[i];
        if (choice == maxBob && choice + aliceChoices[i] > minWin) {
            minWin = choice + aliceChoices[i];
        }
    }

    // Using maximum of aliceChoices
    int maxAlice = *std::max_element(aliceChoices.begin(), aliceChoices.end());
    for (int i = 0; i < turnNum; ++i) {
        int choice = aliceChoices[i];
        if (choice == maxAlice && choice + bobChoices[i] > minWin) {
            minWin = choice + bobChoices[i];
        }
    }

    if (minWin > turnNum) {
        minWin = minWin - turnNum;
    } else {
        minWin = 0;
    }

    std::cout << minWin << " " << maxWin << std::endl;

    return 0;
}
